title: RegDivergence-101: An LLM Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdiction Regulatory Contradiction Detection in Life Sciences
abstract: arXiv:2608.28607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pharmaceutical sponsors developing a drug for both the United States and the European Union must reconcile guidance issued independently by the FDA and the EMA. Where the two agencies require substantively the same thing, a sponsor can file once; where they diverge, a single trial design risks rejection in one region; where one agency is silent on a point the other regulates, the sponsor must infer obligations. Today this reconciliation is performed manually by regulatory-affairs experts. We introduce cross-jurisdiction regulatory divergence detection: given an FDA requirement and an EMA requirement on the same topic, classify their relationship as AGREE, DIVERGE, or SILENT. SILENT is inherently directional (SILENT_FDA vs. SILENT_EMA); we record direction per pair and report per-direction F1 alongside the collapsed label. translated_title: RegDivergence-101：一个用于生命科学领域跨司法辖区监管矛盾检测的大语言模型基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28607v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：同时在美国和欧盟开发药物的制药申办方必须协调由FDA和EMA独立发布的指导原则。当两个机构实质上要求相同时，申办方可以一次性申报；当两者存在分歧时，单一试验设计可能在一个地区被拒；当一个机构对另一机构监管的某一点保持沉默时，申办方必须自行推断义务。目前，这种协调工作由法规事务专家手动完成。我们提出了跨司法辖区监管分歧检测任务：给定FDA和EMA关于同一主题的要求，将其关系分类为AGREE（一致）、DIVERGE（分歧）或SILENT（沉默）。SILENT本质上是方向性的（SILENT_FDA与SILENT_EMA不同）；我们记录每一对的方向，并在合并标签之外报告每个方向的F1分数。我们发布了RegDivergence-101，一个包含101对样本、由专家标注的试点评估基准（标签基于三篇同行评审文献……）
tldr: 该论文提出了“跨司法辖区监管分歧检测”这一新任务，并发布了首个由专家标注的101对样本基准RegDivergence-101，用于评估大语言模型将FDA与EMA监管要求的关系判定为一致、分歧或方向性沉默的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the task of cross-jurisdiction regulatory divergence detection and releases RegDivergence-101, a 101-pair expert-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to classify FDA-EMA regulatory requirements as AGREE, DIVERGE, or directional SILENT.
